estimates.anchor_source: No market or consensus prices the statement (Kalshi KXABNB nights ladder, Polymarket price ladders only, 2026-09-17T08:21:21Z). Anchor = the skill's pending-decision flat prior (0.50) for a discretionary management statement. Base rate: a qualifying statement (down y/y, or incentives/new businesses named as reducing the take rate) in 1 of 5 prints of the new-business regime (2Q26 call only), Laplace 0.29; all-letters class 2 of 13 (0.20). Decomposition: union of the letter-lower route (0.12), the incentives-named route (topic 0.80 x qualifies 0.50) and the FY27 route (0.06), Gaussian copula rho 0.5.
estimates.independence_note: final = 0.5 x 0.48 + 0.3 x 0.29 + 0.2 x 0.50 = 0.43 -> 0.42; built from the letter record and the 2Q26 call form, not from the prior

model.structure: three correlated Bernoulli routes (Gaussian copula rho 0.5): (a) letter Q4 sentence 'lower' 0.12; (b) take rate a topic 0.80 x answer names incentives/new businesses/pilot as reducing a qualifying period's take rate 0.50; (c) explicit FY27 lower 0.06; YES = a | b | c = 0.48; strict convention (FY26 wording excluded, 0.55 of route b survives) = 0.33
model.conventions: statement must be forward-looking at 5 Nov with a period including 4Q26 or FY27 (an FY26 statement on 5 Nov qualifies; 3Q26 realised does not); leg (a) requires 'lower/down/decline' y/y (flat/in-line do not count alone); leg (b) requires incentives, new businesses or the host-fee/direct-link pilot named as reducing the forward take rate (the 2Q26 call form counts; RNPL timing alone counts only under (a)); letter, prepared remarks and Q&A all count

impact.note: If Yes the market marks 4Q26 take rate -13bp (the Street's +13bp becomes flat: -$30M on $23.0bn GBV) and FY27 -15bp (-$170M on ~$114bn GBV, ~-1.1pt of FY27 revenue growth; the mirror of R04's +20bp); ~90% flow-through gives FY26 -0.2pp, FY27 -1.0pp, FY27 EPS -$0.21. Stock -$6 = -1.1pt x 0.40-0.48 turns x $9-10 (~-$4.6) plus the FY27 EBITDA level effect (~-$4), haircut because the modal form is the 2Q26 'flat, with incentives' sentence. EV 0.42 x -6 = -$2.5/share: material; carry as a named bonus line and pre-write the reply to R04.
